comment: The 'profile' array above is an ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER (a few arbitrary steps), NOT a real WLTP/UDDS/multisine trace -- replace it with your actual validation current sequence before running (current in Amps, since current_unit='A' here so values map 1:1 to the cell terminals, unlike the C-rate-scaled tests elsewhere). Run 04a_validation_prep_80pct.json immediately before this one, so the cell starts from a known ~80% SOC after a known charge+rest. This file must never be used for fitting -- it's the held-out set the fit is judged on.
